title: bug: JetBrains Release Agent never sends force, so releasing a task whose seat is mid-step (a hung or crashed worker) is refused STEP_LEASE_HELD and the board has no override, although /ws forwards force for exactly this (c593eb13)
description:
Filed by defect hunt 11-03 #4 (task-130a6a5c). Evidence is from HEAD 430e4620.

PROBLEM
A seat that hangs or crashes mid-step leaves its task WORKING and assigned, with one step IN_PROGRESS. That is exactly the task a human releases from the board. The daemon refuses that release unless the caller passes `force`. The JetBrains plugin never sends it, and nothing in the plugin lets the user opt in.

Daemon (emitter and acceptor):
- packages/moe-daemon/src/server/WebSocketServer.ts:735-745 (case 'RELEASE_TASK'). The comment reads "Forward `force` so the board keeps a way past the step lease. ... without this the documented human override would be unreachable from the UI that most needs it. Absent/false still means 'refuse a leased row' — the human opts in explicitly." The code then passes `force: message.payload.force === true` to release_task. This came in with c593eb13 (2026-08-20).
- packages/moe-daemon/src/util/claimGuards.ts:265-277 assertNoLiveLease: `if (force) return; if (!task.assignedWorkerId) return; ... const step = inProgressStep(task); if (!step) return; throw new MoeError(... 'pass force:true to override a confirmed-dead holder', ..., STEP_LEASE_HELD)`. The /ws call has no workerId, so assertReleaseCaller (:290-293) is a no-op and the lease check is the one that bites.
- The /ws ERROR frame carries only operation, codeName and message. error.context is never spread (WebSocketServer.ts:39-55, allowlist = the two plan revisions), so the plugin cannot read the holder, the step or the taskId from the refusal.

Plugin (consumer):
- moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeCommandSender.kt:147-156 `fun releaseTask(taskId: String, reason: String? = null)`. The payload is {taskId, reason?}, then `sendMessage("RELEASE_TASK", payload)`. There is no `"force"` anywhere under moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin.
- Every entry point ends there:
  - the card's context menu, TaskCard.kt:345-347 then onReleaseAgent;
  - MoeToolWindowPanel.kt:547-557 handleReleaseAgent: a Yes/No dialog, then `service.releaseTask(task.id, MoeBundle.message("moe.message.releasedInUI"))`;
  - TaskDetailDialog.kt:725-739, the Release Agent action, with the same dialog and call;
  - MoeProjectService.kt:555, the pass-through.
- The confirmation text (MoeBundle.properties:102) promises "The task stays claimable where it is ... and the agent goes idle". For a mid-step task the daemon refuses, the user gets a generic ERROR balloon (MoeToolWindowPanel.kt:349-355), and the hung seat keeps the task.
- The only workaround is to drag the card to Backlog or Planning, which takes the task out of its column.

EVIDENCE
- Repro: a daemon vitest drives the real /ws server and sends the plugin's exact frames. First CLIENT_HELLO as in MoeCommandSender.sendClientHello, then `RELEASE_TASK {taskId, reason:"Released from board"}`, against a task that is WORKING, assigned to w-mid, with step-1 IN_PROGRESS.
- Command: `cd /tmp/hunt-130a-A/packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/server/releaseForce.repro.test.ts --reporter=verbose`. Verbatim output:
  ```
  JetBrains frame reply: {"type":"ERROR","operation":"RELEASE_TASK","codeName":"STEP_LEASE_HELD","message":"[STEP_LEASE_HELD] Task task-1 is leased by w-mid with step step-1 IN_PROGRESS; pass force:true to override a confirmed-dead holder"}
  force:true reply: {"type":"TASK_UPDATED","status":"WORKING","assignedWorkerId":null}
   Tests  2 passed (2)
  ```
  The second case is the same frame plus force:true, and it releases the row.
- Saved in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt-130a/A/: releaseForce.repro.test.ts and releaseForce.repro.output.txt. The filer re-ran it at 17:05Z with the same result.
- task-9f6a725f (VSC-6, VS Code) left force out only "because JetBrains never sends it". That is a parity argument, not a product decision. The daemon comment and the c593eb13 message both say the board is meant to have the override.

FIX DIRECTION (plugin-only; the daemon is already correct)
- MoeCommandSender.releaseTask gains `force: Boolean = false`. Add `"force": true` to the payload only when it is set. The default frame must stay byte-identical: {taskId, reason?} with no force key.
- Decide whether to force from the rendered state, before sending. A refusal cannot be correlated, because the ERROR frame has no taskId.
  - Add a small pure helper, headless-testable, that mirrors assertNoLiveLease. For an assigned task with an IN_PROGRESS implementationPlan step, it returns (holder, stepId). Otherwise it returns null.
  - When it returns a value, show a second, explicit confirmation that names the holder and the step and says a force release is for a holder you believe is dead. Send force:true only on Yes. Declining sends nothing.
  - When it returns null, the release is unchanged and sends no force key.
- Apply this to both entry points: handleReleaseAgent, which the card menu uses, and TaskDetailDialog's Release Agent action. Prefer routing the dialog through one shared handler over duplicating the logic.
- If the board was stale (a step started after the render), the daemon still refuses and the existing balloon shows. That is acceptable.

Out of scope: moe-vscode/** (a VS Code twin can be filed separately), any daemon change, docs/MCP_SERVER.md.

FILES (planner to confirm):
- moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeCommandSender.kt
- services/MoeProjectService.kt
- toolwindow/MoeToolWindowPanel.kt
- toolwindow/TaskDetailDialog.kt
- src/main/resources/messages/MoeBundle.properties (the new confirmation text)
- a new test modelled on moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/services/MoeCommandSenderAccountsTest.kt

Gate: `./gradlew test` needs the jetbrains-gradle lease (mem:convention-jetbrains-gradle-lease; for traps see mem:gotcha-gradle-jetbrains-shared-box).
definitionOfDone: A new headless JetBrains unit test asserts the exact RELEASE_TASK frame MoeCommandSender sends. The default call has payload {taskId, reason} and no "force" key. The force path has "force": true. A blank reason still omits "reason", as today.

A pure helper decides when a force release is needed, and it is unit-tested. An assigned task with an IN_PROGRESS step yields that holder and stepId, mirroring claimGuards.ts assertNoLiveLease. An unassigned task, or a plan with no IN_PROGRESS step (only PENDING/COMPLETED, or empty), yields null, and the plain no-force release is used.

Both entry points (the card menu, through MoeToolWindowPanel.handleReleaseAgent, and TaskDetailDialog's Release Agent action) send force:true only after a second, explicit confirmation that names the holder and step. Declining it sends no frame, and a non-mid-step release is unchanged.
`moe-jetbrains\gradlew.bat -p moe-jetbrains test --rerun`, run under the jetbrains-gradle lease, passes, and build/test-results show the new test classes executed with 0 failures

implementationPlan.description: DoD 2 and the logic of DoD 3. Create moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/BoardRelease.kt from /mnt/d/moe-scratch/plan-0f2e/BoardRelease.kt (sha256 773ae56cb8ffec3f71bcf4e6582c178f952a2f7265613c6eaae1a4c7b85cc5b2). It is shaped like BoardApproval.kt: a pure decision, an internal headless flow, and an EDT adapter. It contains: data class StepLease(holder, stepId); enum Outcome {CANCELLED, RELEASED, FORCE_RELEASED, STALE}; and internal const FORCE_MESSAGE_KEY, FORCE_TITLE_KEY and STALE_MESSAGE_KEY. `fun stepLease(task: Task?): StepLease?` mirrors packages/moe-daemon/src/util/claimGuards.ts assertNoLiveLease and inProgressStep for a caller with no workerId, which is the /ws path. It returns a lease only for a non-empty assignedWorkerId (isNullOrEmpty, matching JS falsiness), on the FIRST implementationPlan step whose status is IN_PROGRESS (the daemon uses find). Otherwise it returns null. `internal fun release(rendered, confirmRelease, confirmForce, latest, send, stale): Outcome` works like this. A blank assignee gives CANCELLED and asks nothing. If the first confirmation is declined: CANCELLED. With no lease it calls send(false) and returns RELEASED, the unchanged plain frame. With a lease it asks confirmForce(lease); declined: CANCELLED. Then it fails closed: if stepLease(latest()) != the confirmed lease, it calls stale(lease), returns STALE and sends nothing. Otherwise it calls send(true) and returns FORCE_RELEASED. `fun releaseRendered(project, service, task): Outcome` is the EDT-only adapter. It starts with check(SwingUtilities.isEventDispatchThread()). The first Yes/No reuses the existing moe.message.releaseAgent text, its title and the question icon. The second is a Yes/No with the WARNING icon and MoeBundle.message(FORCE_MESSAGE_KEY, lease.holder, lease.stepId, task.title). The other parameters: latest = { service.getState()?.tasks?.firstOrNull { it.id == task.id } }; send = service.releaseTask(task.id, MoeBundle.message("moe.message.releasedInUI"), force); stale = Messages.showWarningDialog(project, the STALE text, the FORCE title). Why the cache read: the ERROR frame has no taskId, so the decision comes from the rendered task before sending, as the description says. But MoeNotificationService.ViewTaskAction can open TaskDetailDialog with a snapshot hours old, and force must never reach a different live seat. The cache read never picks what is sent. Bundle: insert the 3 lines from edits.md section 3 right after `moe.message.releaseAgentTitle=Release Agent` in MoeBundle.properties. Use pure ASCII and no apostrophe, because MessageFormat reads a single quote as an escape; the file is LF. Create moe-jetbrains/src/test/kotlin/com/moe/toolwindow/BoardReleaseTest.kt from the reference (sha256 2bd2fba4da7f77bd5d2b46cc3af32c87a53859885fff3f13fd7f6557308302d9), 10 tests. stepLease: the holder plus the first IN_PROGRESS step; null for a null task, a null or empty assignee, an empty plan, and a PENDING/COMPLETED-only plan. The flow drives a REAL MoeCommandSender, so each case asserts exact frames. The plain path sends only the plain frame and never asks about force. Mid-step sends force only after the second question received StepLease(w-mid, step-2), also when latest is an equal-lease copy. Declining either question sends nothing. A lease that changed while confirming (another holder, another step, no step, unassigned, missing) sends nothing and shows the stale warning. An unassigned or blank rendered task asks nothing. Then 2 source guards (step 3 turns the wiring guard green) and a bundle guard that loads /messages/MoeBundle.properties as java.util.Properties. Never call MoeBundle from a test (mem:pattern-jetbrains-headless-pure-render-helper). Test names must not contain . : ; / < > [ ] or a backslash (mem:gotcha-kotlin-test-names-no-dot). Error handling: there are no new exception paths. A non-EDT call throws IllegalStateException from check(), and the card's safeCallback turns that into an error balloon. If the board was stale and a step started after the render, the plain release still gets the daemon's STEP_LEASE_HELD and the existing ERROR balloon, which the description accepts. A confirmed force whose lease has changed sends nothing and says so.

executionContract.intendedBehavior: Release Agent works from the JetBrains board card menu and from Task Detail even when the task's seat hung or crashed mid-step. If the task the user clicked (the rendered snapshot) has an assignee and an IN_PROGRESS plan step, the existing confirmation is followed by a second, explicit warning. That warning names the holder and the step, and says a force release is only for a holder believed dead. Yes sends RELEASE_TASK with force:true, but only while the plugin's newest cached copy of the task still shows that same holder and step. Otherwise nothing is sent, and a warning says the task changed. No sends nothing. Every other release sends exactly the frame it sends today: {taskId, reason}, with no force key.
acceptanceCriteria: MoeCommandSenderReleaseTest asserts the raw RELEASE_TASK frames. The default call (and force = false) sends {taskId, reason} with no force key. force = true appends "force":true. A blank or missing reason is omitted with and without force.

BoardRelease.stepLease returns StepLease(holder, first IN_PROGRESS stepId) for an assigned task. It returns null for a null task, a null or empty assignee, an empty plan, or a plan with only PENDING/COMPLETED steps.

BoardRelease.release, driven with a real MoeCommandSender, behaves as follows. A non-mid-step release sends only the plain frame and never asks about force. A mid-step release sends force only after confirmForce received the holder and step. Declining either confirmation sends no frame. A lease that changed between the confirmation and the send yields STALE with no frame.

MoeToolWindowPanel.handleReleaseAgent (the card menu) and the Release Agent action in TaskDetailDialog both call BoardRelease.releaseRendered(project, service, task), and service.releaseTask( appears only in BoardRelease.kt.
The checkRef passes under the jetbrains-gradle lease. The XML for both new test classes shows failures=0 errors=0.
invariants: force:true is sent only after the second confirmation, and only while the cached task still shows the confirmed holder and step.
Declining either confirmation sends no frame.
stepLease mirrors claimGuards.ts assertNoLiveLease/inProgressStep for a caller with no workerId: a non-empty assignee plus the first IN_PROGRESS step.
The decision comes from the rendered snapshot. The cache read is only a fail-closed re-check and never chooses what is sent.
service.releaseTask( is called only from BoardRelease.kt.
compatibility: The default RELEASE_TASK frame stays byte-identical: {"type":"RELEASE_TASK","payload":{"taskId":...,"reason":...}}, with reason omitted when blank and no force key.
Existing callers compile unchanged because the new parameter is defaulted. This includes PlanApprovalContractTest's throwing.releaseTask("task-1", "reason").
The daemon's /ws RELEASE_TASK contract (WebSocketServer.ts forwards force only when it === true) is consumed as-is. No daemon, moe-vscode or docs/MCP_SERVER.md change.
The existing bundle keys moe.message.releaseAgent, releaseAgentTitle and releasedInUI keep their text.
fun handleReleaseAgent(task: Task) keeps its name, because it is a BoardApprovalTest source-slice anchor.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Send force on every board release. Rejected: it would bypass the step lease that protects live seats. (2) Retry with force after a STEP_LEASE_HELD ERROR. Impossible: the /ws ERROR frame carries no taskId (the allowlist at WebSocketServer.ts:39-55 holds only plan revisions). (3) Pass TaskDetailDialog a callback into the panel's local handleReleaseAgent. Rejected: MoeNotificationService.ViewTaskAction also opens the dialog, without callbacks. A shared object reaches every opener, as BoardApproval already does for Approve. (4) One combined dialog for mid-step tasks. Rejected: the DoD asks for a second, explicit confirmation. (5) Decide from service.getState() rather than the rendered task. Rejected per the task description and BoardApproval's rendered-snapshot rule. The cache is read only as a fail-closed re-check before force, because a notification-opened dialog can show an hours-old holder, and force must never strip a different live seat.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: BoardApproval.kt is the template: a pure decide(), an internal dispatch() with injected effects for headless tests, and an EDT-only approveRendered. Plugin unit tests run on a bare JVM with JUnit 4 and no IntelliJ Application. Consequences: MoeBundle cannot be called from a test (load MoeBundle.properties with java.util.Properties instead), and UI wiring is pinned with source guards (substringAfter/substringBefore anchors, plus a check that throws when the source file is missing). JUnit creates a fresh test instance per method, so capture lists reset. Kotlin internal declarations are visible from the test source set. Gson's JsonObject.toString() writes keys in insertion order with no whitespace, so raw-string equality proves byte identity. The worktree is LF. The bundle already holds non-ASCII values elsewhere; add none.
planningNotes.risks: MessageFormat: one apostrophe in a new bundle value silently drops text, so use none (the bundle guard checks). Test names cannot contain . : ; / < > [ ] or a backslash. Removing or renaming fun handleReleaseAgent breaks BoardApprovalTest's handleNext slice. `> Task :test UP-TO-DATE` executes nothing, so use --rerun and read the XML. An architect could not compile the reference bytes; the first gated run is the compile check. Read the first Kotlin error, because they cascade. Mutate only in an archive copy, never the worktree. The diff is about +350 net LOC (runtime about +115, tests about +232) against the 400 review cap, so keep KDoc short if fixes grow it. A VS Code twin (task-9f6a725f VSC-6 left force out on JetBrains parity) is out of scope and may be filed separately.

completionSummary:
JetBrains Release Agent can now force-release a task whose seat is mid-step. The change is plugin-only.
- MoeCommandSender.releaseTask and MoeProjectService.releaseTask gain `force: Boolean = false`. The force key is appended after reason only when true, so the default frame {taskId, reason?} is byte-identical.
- New com.moe.toolwindow.BoardRelease, shaped like BoardApproval:
  - stepLease(Task?) mirrors claimGuards.ts assertNoLiveLease for a caller with no workerId: a non-empty assignee plus the FIRST IN_PROGRESS step.
  - internal release() is the headless flow. A non-mid-step release sends the plain frame without asking about force. A mid-step release asks a second warning question that names the holder, the step and the title. It then fails closed if the cached task (service.getState()) no longer shows the same lease: STALE with a warning, and no frame. It sends force:true only on Yes. Declining either question sends nothing.
  - releaseRendered() is the EDT adapter.
- MoeToolWindowPanel.handleReleaseAgent (the card menu, name kept) and TaskDetailDialog's Release Agent both call BoardRelease.releaseRendered. The dialog stays open on CANCELLED. service.releaseTask( now appears only in BoardRelease.kt.
- Three new ASCII bundle keys: releaseAgentForce, releaseAgentForceTitle and releaseAgentForceStale.
- Tests:
  - MoeCommandSenderReleaseTest (4) compares raw frames.
  - BoardReleaseTest (10) covers stepLease cases and the flow driven through a real MoeCommandSender, with exact frames. It also has 2 source guards and a bundle Properties guard.
- Gate: gradlew test --rerun under the jetbrains-gradle lease, 649 tests (base 635 + 14), 0 failures, 6 skipped.
- Mutants M1-M4 were run in the archive copy /mnt/d/moe-scratch/m-0f2e and all were killed by the expected tests.
- No daemon, moe-vscode or docs change. Net LOC is about +348.
